title: Why Coherent (COHR) Is Up 11.9% After Nvidia’s AI Optics Deal And Equity Investment
title_zh: 为什么相干公司 (COHR) 在 Nvidia 的 AI 光学交易和股权投资后上涨 11.9%
summary: In recent days, Coherent Corp. reported strong growth in its Data Center & Communications segment and secured a multibillion‑dollar AI datacenter infrastructure partnership with Nvidia, which also took an equity stake to support expanded photonics capacity.
summary_zh: 最近几天，相干公司报告其数据中心和通信部门强劲增长，并与英伟达建立了价值数十亿美元的人工智能数据中心基础设施合作伙伴关系，英伟达还持有股权以支持扩大的光子学能力。

title: Greg Abel Puts His Stamp on Berkshire Hathaway With Pair of Megadeals
title_zh: 格雷格·阿贝尔 (Greg Abel) 通过两项大型交易为伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司 (Berkshire Hathaway) 留下了自己的印记
summary: In one weekend, Warren Buffett’s successor has given shareholders a reason to believe he is a savvy dealmaker.
summary_zh: 在一个周末，沃伦·巴菲特的继任者让股东有理由相信他是一位精明的交易撮合者。

title: Broadcom Backing Lowers Debt Costs on $36 Billion Anthropic Deal
title_zh: Broadcom 支持降低 360 亿美元 Anthropic 交易的债务成本
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Broadcom Inc.’s promise to backstop the largest portion of a record-setting microchip financing deal for Anthropic is keeping yields for the deal in check, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——据知情人士透露，博通公司承诺支持 Anthropic 创纪录的微芯片融资交易的最大部分，这使得该交易的收益率受到控制。

title: Pricing details emerge on $36B private credit deal for Anthropic
title_zh: Anthropic 36B 美元私人信贷交易的定价细节浮出水面
summary: Pricing details have emerged on the $36 billion of investment-grade structured notes being shopped around by Apollo and Blackstone to private credit investors as part of a deal to purchase and then lease chips to AI giant Anthropic, according to market sources.
summary_zh: 据市场消息人士透露，阿波罗和黑石向私人信贷投资者出售 360 亿美元的投资级结构性票据，作为购买芯片然后租赁给人工智能巨头 Anthropic 交易的一部分，定价细节已经公布。

title: Berkshire Hathaway Got a Sweet Deal on Alphabet Stock
title_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司获得了 Alphabet 股票的优惠交易
summary: Alphabet, Google’s parent, gave Berkshire a 6% discount off its Monday closing stock price. It isn’t that unusual—for very good reasons.
summary_zh: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 给予伯克希尔周一收盘价 6% 的折扣。这并不罕见——有充分的理由。
